race.comment: AMERICAN IMAGE (4) was too good two starts ago before remaining at 1400m last start and closing nicely, missing by 1.1L. Pike now reunites with the filly and getting out in distance is a big tick for her. She's a nice type on the way up and she can go one better this time around. LADY MONEY TALK (6) was solid out to the mile for the first time last start where she jumped favourite at Northam. Chris Parnham now takes the ride and out to 1700m will be no issue. Showing some ability and can feature in the finish once again. CONCHETTA'S DREAM (5) improved last start getting out to this track and trip for the first time where she closed off impressively behind a handy type. Now gets the blinkers on and the chance to sit closer in the run. DOUBLE THE FUN (2) gets the blinkers on third-up and out in distance. Can improve again now. VALANNE DAWN (9) makes some appeal on the back of her last start win.
